name: Cirion BUE1 Buenos Aires Data Center
notes: Carrier-neutral data center at Av. del Campo 1301 in CABA; official page describes it as Argentina's most connected data center interconnecting hyperscalers, service providers, and corporations.

name: Cirion BUE1 Buenos Aires Data Center Expansion
notes: Cirion announced it was executing a BUE1 expansion adding more than 2MW and about 160 additional racks.

name: EdgeConneX Buenos Aires Data Center BUE01
notes: Official EdgeConneX page lists BUE01 as a multi-tenant carrier-neutral Buenos Aires data center with 3.5MW N+1 capacity and 10.5MW site-capable power.

name: IPLAN Ringo DCI Data Center
notes: IPLAN describes Ringo DCI as a Tier III-category data center in the CABA technology district; service document places it at Los Patos 2948, CABA.

name: Claro Buenos Aires 2 / San Telmo Modular Data Center
notes: DCD reported Claro launched the Buenos Aires modular facility after a US$30M project; Fibratel describes 650kW IT power, 90 expandable racks, and a 736 sqm built area on a 2,647.80 sqm site.

name: Personal / Telecom Pacheco Data Center
notes: Personal Tech official page lists Datacenter Pacheco in Buenos Aires with 5,700 sqm IT area and Tier III positioning; BNamericas reported 10MW capacity for Telecom's main Pacheco data center.

name: ARSAT Benavidez Tier III Data Center
notes: DCD identifies ARSAT's operational 4,200 sqm Tier III certified data center at its Benavidez earth station in Tigre Partido, Buenos Aires; datacenters.com summarizes four 365 sqm rooms and a high-security room.

name: ARSAT Benavidez Room IV Expansion
notes: Reported US$17M expansion of the Benavidez data center, adding Tier III Room IV with 620kW IT load and rack densities from 4kW to 15kW.

name: Telecentro Data Center
notes: Telecentro official page markets its enterprise data center; DataCenterMap places the facility in Buenos Aires province with 600-rack capacity and 1.25MW.

name: Proposed Chaco Data Center / First Northern Argentina Data Center
developer: Agencia de Inversiones de Chaco / undisclosed investor
notes: DataChaco reported the president of Chaco's investment agency, Martin Braillard Poccard, discussed a concrete investor-backed data center project that could become the first in northern Argentina; no site, capacity, or final approval found.

name: Green Capital Atlas GigaHub / Trelew Hyperscale AI Data Center
notes: Green Capital announced the Atlas GigaHub hyperscale AI factory/data center campus in Chubut, tied to Trelew/Zona Franca and renewable power. Public reports cite US$3.3B to US$5B initial investment and a 3GW data center concept; construction timing depends on investor/project close.

name: Chubut Hub Digital 2030 Data Centers
developer: Government of Chubut / ENACOM / future investors
notes: Chubut Hub Digital 2030 aims to attract infrastructure operators using a second submarine cable landing point and Atlantic-Pacific digital corridor; BNamericas describes two wind-powered Tier IV data centers but notes no operator or investor secured for that portion.

name: Cirion COR1 Cordoba Data Center
notes: Listed colocation facility at Av. Velez Sarsfield 4445 in Cordoba operated by Cirion Technologies.

name: Claro Data Center Cordoba / Cordoba NOC modernization
notes: DataCenterMap reports Claro is building a new NOC and modernizing its existing Cordoba data center near Miguel Cane 4100, with over 2,000 sqm and more than US$100M investment; ColoMap confirms a Claro Cordoba colocation data center at that address.

name: Telecom Cordoba Oeste Data Center
notes: ColoMap and datacenters.com list Telecom Cordoba Oeste as a Telecom Argentina colocation data center at Cnel. Pedro Zanni 306, Cordoba.

name: Poder Judicial de Corrientes Data Center
notes: DCD reported a new provincial judiciary data center in Corrientes, inaugurated in the new IT directorate building on March 2, 2015.

name: Entre Rios Provincial Data Center
notes: Provincial government data center in Parana/Entre Rios inaugurated in 2023; reports state it triples the province's storage and processing capacity for the next 40 years.

name: Banco Formosa Prefabricated Data Center
notes: DCE Ingenieria public video/social posts identify Banco Formosa's all-in-one prefabricated data center as 40-foot, 50kW, 12 racks, TIA-942 Rated 3; Enfasys later quotes DCE saying it has a Formosa installation operating for over a decade.

name: Jujuy Provincial Government Data Center
developer: Government of Jujuy / Ministry of Finance
notes: Jujuy inaugurated its first provincial government data center at the San Salvador de Jujuy bus terminal site in 2022 with ARS 500M investment; 2026 local coverage says about 80% of ministry data had been integrated there.
